title: Sandcastle Knight
author: Claude
blurb: Teddy, a Pembroke Welsh Corgi in a tin helmet, takes back the backyard sandbox after his big sister Gwin's zoomies flattened every castle. Build towers of sand, toss tennis balls, show off your tricks!

box.tagline: Build the towers. Toss the ball. Good boy!
box.back:
Summer, 1995. Teddy is a Pembroke Welsh Corgi and the knight of the backyard sandbox: tin helmet, red plume, short legs, big heart. He knows lots of tricks, he loves his toys, and everybody loves him.

Then his big sister Gwin, a brown pit-lab mix twice his size, came through with the zoomies. Every castle flattened. Hose on, kiddie pool tipped, a hole dug under the whole sandbox, and Teddy's toys scattered everywhere. Now she's snoring on the patio, right on top of the Crown of the Sandbox.

Scoop sand, dig dunes, plug anthills and build tower after tower until the gates rise. Ride the hose currents, time the tide, and when Gwin's in the way, toss her a tennis ball. She can't resist one.
features: Five castles and a whole sandbox to roam, plus a secret dial-up to THE -= S A N D B O X =- BBS
Teddy knows tricks: sit, spin, roll over, jump and play dead, each on its own key (spinning even bowls over ants)
Gwin naps in doorways and galumphs about: toss her a tennis ball and off she trots
Squeaky bones, flying discs, dog biscuits and peanut butter scattered all over the sandbox
Hose currents, crumbling bridges, rolling waves and a tidal flat that floods
A sleeping big sister six blocks wide, with paws you must splash back
Animated FLI intro and story, VGA graphics and PC speaker sound - no sound card needed

reviews.quote: Sir Grit is the bravest thumb-sized hero of 1995. Bring a towel.
Runs on any old PC - and the kids would not give it back.
